Package com.example.masroofy.data

Class DatabaseHelper

java.lang.Object
android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper
com.example.masroofy.data.DatabaseHelper
All Implemented Interfaces:
IDataRepository, AutoCloseable
public class DatabaseHelper extends android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper implements IDataRepository
SQLite implementation of the data repository. Manages the local database for budget cycles and expenses.
